title: Local derived completeness for a ring-sheaf quotient kernel
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $q:\mathcal O\to\mathcal S$ a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings, and $M$ an object of the standard unbounded derived category of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The kernel ideal sheaf $\ker(q)$ has sections $\ker(q_U)$ on every site object $U$ and is a ringed-site ideal [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-ideal]. Define $\operatorname{IsComplete}(q,M)$ to be the local derived ringed-ideal completeness predicate [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete] for this kernel: on every slice over $U$, internal derived Hom from the localization at each section of $\ker(q)(U)$ into the restriction of $M$ vanishes. This is a predicate on arbitrary derived objects; completeness is not an assumption.
